summary: Read-only review completed against socket-baseline.json at HEAD b3e44990d9272327fef042439f1a6555eaae8c4f. Recommend nominal socket registration without moving PCB footprints, subject to the two conditions below. Confidence: high for XY, moderate for Z. Implementation, collision clearance and physical product remain unverified.

findings.claim: Resolve terminal contact plane before freezing Z; housing-shoulder alignment puts observed terminal material 0.15 mm inside the board.
evidence: socket-probe.log: shoulder z=-1.768321335; terminal upper plane z=-1.618321335. Native underside is 3.8 mm in check_pcb_step_registration.py. Terminal-based candidate dz=5.418321335 predicts socket minimum z=1.95 mm.
Probe includes only 18 largest horizontal faces; all terminal contact faces and both pad overlaps remain unchecked.
components/sources.json pins socket FCStd SHA256 9edce0ece1a32a929694912a38509c972078767c0f6456d6e5040359c57bae78 and labels the purchased variant unmeasured.

findings.claim: Existing STEP checks exclude hot-swap sockets; explicitly verify all 36 instances and underside collisions.
evidence: Both PCBs contain 18 F.Cu switch footprints; socket pads are B.Cu. Probe boss centers support approximately (-0.00616,+0.02606) mm XY translation followed by actual footprint rotation, without reflection.
components/switches.json leaves socket placement unqualified; choc-envelope excludes sockets; check_pcb_step_registration.py checks U1/J2/J1/SW1/SW2 only.

recommendations: Proceed with source-pinned nominal modeling. Confirm complete terminal coplanarity, both pad overlaps and absence of unintended board penetration before fixing Z.

Verify 18 sockets per half, boss datums, thumb rotations, serialized geometry and numerical collision distances against all underside components and enclosure features. Extend actual KiCad STEP readback if sockets enter delivered PCB models.
Keep physical_acceptance false; different purchased geometry, source hash or mating-plane evidence changes the recommendation.
